description: A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Computer Repair Shop Management System up to 1.0. Affected is an unknown function of the file /admin/products/manage_product.php. The manipulation of the argument ID results in sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.
